job: Mark a launch or milestone with one full-width accent panel.
purpose: An accent surface for a launch or milestone at the top of an overview, with an ASCII flame field on each side and the message in the clear middle. It is the one place a whole surface may be accent. Under 640px the end art drops away and the start art becomes a band across the top.
useWhen: A launch, milestone or release is the headline of the page and gets one hero moment.
A product overview opens with one statement and one or two actions.

avoidWhen.when: The message is one line about the account, such as a trial ending.
The message belongs to a section and needs a tone.
A short, fleeting confirmation after an action.
Several announcements compete on the page.
avoidWhen.instead: Use one announce per view and move the rest to a list or a changelog.

variants.useWhen: The art on the leading edge; on phones it becomes the band at the top.
The art on the trailing edge; it is dropped under 640px.

parts.role: A texture field at one side; set data-side to place it.
A small pill above the title, such as "New".
